title: Count Items Matching a Rule
summary: Given an array of items with type, color, and name, count how many items match a specified rule based on type, color, or name, as defined by ruleKey and ruleValue.
statement: Given an array of items with type, color, and name, count how many items match a specified rule based on type, color, or name, as defined by ruleKey and ruleValue.
constraints: Count items whose field selected by rule_key equals rule_value exactly.
hints: The rule key selects one fixed position in every three-field item.
Map type, color, and name to indices zero, one, and two.
Count rows whose selected field equals the rule value.
The mapping is the item schema, so the equality test is exactly the rule definition for every row.
